products.description: Help water and chemicals soak into the fabric quickly and evenly.

products.name: Detergents & scouring agents
products.description: Remove oils, waxes, dirt and natural impurities.

products.name: Desizing enzymes
products.description: Amylase enzymes that break down the starch size applied during weaving.

products.name: Sequestering & chelating agents
products.description: Lock up calcium, magnesium and iron in hard water so they don't cause spots or uneven bleaching.

products.name: Peroxide stabilisers
products.description: Control how fast hydrogen peroxide works during bleaching, preventing fabric damage.

products.name: Peroxide killers
products.description: Catalase enzymes that remove leftover peroxide before dyeing.

products.name: Bio-polishing enzymes
products.description: Cellulase enzymes that remove surface fuzz for a cleaner, smoother look.

products.name: Mercerising wetting agents
products.description: Work in strong caustic baths during mercerisation.

products.name: Demineralising agents
products.description: Remove metal ions from cotton.

groups.title: Dyeing
groups.description: Used to put colour on evenly, deep and fast.

products.name: Levelling agents
products.description: Help dye go on evenly, for uniform shades without patches.

products.name: Dispersing agents
products.description: Keep dye finely spread in the bath so it doesn't clump or spot.

products.name: Anti-creasing agents & lubricants
products.description: Let fabric glide through the machine without crease or rope marks.

products.name: Defoamers
products.description: Knock down foam in the bath to prevent foam spots.

products.name: pH buffers & acid donors
products.description: Hold or gradually shift bath pH so dye goes on at a controlled rate.

products.name: Carriers
products.description: Help disperse dyes penetrate polyester at lower temperatures.

products.name: Reduction inhibitors & dye protectors
products.description: Protect sensitive dyes from breaking down, so shades stay true.

products.name: Soaping agents
products.description: Wash off unfixed dye after reactive dyeing for brighter shades and better wash fastness.

products.name: Dye-fixing agents
products.description: Lock dye onto the fibre to cut bleeding and improve wet fastness.

products.name: Salt substitutes & exhaust aids
products.description: Help reactive dyes exhaust onto cotton with less salt in the bath.

page_aesop.label: TEXTILE AUXILIARIES / 01
page_aesop.name: AeSop
page_aesop.headline:
Clean shades.
Clear advantage.
page_aesop.description: Polymer wash-off chemistry for reactive-dyed cotton. AeSop removes loose dye and helps keep it from redepositing, so shades stay bright and white grounds stay clean.

benefits.title: Cleaner white grounds
benefits.text: Helps prevent hydrolysed reactive dye from staining adjacent white fabric.

benefits.title: Low-temperature wash-off
benefits.text: Works from 60 °C, with a starting process at 70 °C subject to plant trial.

benefits.title: Low foam in circulation
benefits.text: Surfactant-free chemistry designed for jet, soft-flow and winch machines.

profile.title:
Know your
chemistry.
profile.text: Practical information for your mill, from supplied form to application.

technical.value: 35 kg carboy · 120 kg drum · 1,000 kg IBC

application.title:
A starting point
for your process.

steps.title: Rinse & neutralise
steps.text: Drop the dyebath, cold rinse, then neutralise with acetic acid at 50 °C.

steps.title: Dose & soap
steps.text: Dose AeSop in a fresh bath. The brochure starting recipe is 70 °C for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Rinse & finish
steps.text: Drain and warm rinse at 50 °C before proceeding to softening.

application.note: Shade depth, dye class, liquor ratio, water quality and machine type affect the recipe. Confirm dosage and performance in your own plant trial.

benefits.title: Silky, smooth handle

benefits.title: Whiteness & shade care

benefits.title: Absorbency retained

profile.title:
Know your
chemistry.
profile.text: Practical information for your mill, from supplied form to application.

technical.value: Dispersible in water; no heating needed

application.title:
A starting point
for your process.

steps.title: Prepare the stock
steps.text: Disperse the paste under continuous stirring to a 5–10% stock. No heating is needed. Filter before storage.

steps.title: Apply the softener
steps.text: Exhaust at pH 5–5.5 and 30–40 °C for 20 minutes, or use padding at about 20 °C.

steps.title: Dry & evaluate
steps.text: Dry at 110–130 °C. Check handle, shade and absorbency on your own fabric.

application.note: Dosages below are for a 10% stock dilution. Rinse well after soaping. Anionic auxiliaries may cause precipitation and loss of performance; confirm compatibility by trial.
